summary:
Submitted 5 scenarios. I never saw results for any of them, so none of the findings is confirmed by a run.

1. Per-line stock check: `ensureInventoryLevels` in the inventory module validates each reservation line separately against available quantity. It never adds up lines that share an inventory item, such as OVS-PIECE and OVS-TWOPACK on WIDGET. Attempt 1 tests this with one cart that needs 12 units against stock of 10.
2. Process-local lock: the reservation step takes its lock through the default in-memory locking provider. This only serialises requests inside one server process. Attempts 2, 3 and 4 race completions across two servers.
3. Duplicate completion: attempt 5 completes one cart six times at once on a single server. I did not find a concrete weakness in the code for this, so I am not claiming it.

I am claiming attempt 1 (per-line-check, from the visible code) and attempt 4 (process-local-lock). Attempt 2 is a second two-server lock scenario but I'm leaving it out of the claims.
